title: Sankyo Fever: Jikki Simulation S Vol. 2
native_title: ＳＡＮＫＹＯ ＦＥＶＥＲ 実機シミュレーションＳ Ｖｏｌ．２
overview: Sankyo Fever S Vol.2 is pachinko simulation game, and part of the Fever series. It contains digital recreations of three real-life pachinko machines made by Sankyo: CR Fever Pistol Daimyo SR, Fever Pistol Daimyo GP, and Fever Hanafuda GP; each can be freely played with various pin configurations. There is also a story mode where the player can pursue a relationship with one of two cute girls in between pachinko sessions.
